org.harbourmasters.soh.stdoutHead:
Identifier: org.harbourmasters.soh [desktop-application]
Internal ID: system/flatpak/flatpak/org.harbourmasters.soh/*
Name: Ship of Harkinian
Summary: Enough! My ship sails in the morning!
Bundle: flatpak:app/org.harbourmasters.soh/x86_64/master
Homepage: https://www.shipofharkinian.com/
Icon: org.harbourmasters.soh.png
Developer: Harbour Masters
Description: 
  Ship of Harkinian is a native PC port of the N64 classic, featuring enhanced graphics, mod
  support, and modern controls.
   • 4K, ultrawide, and multi-monitor rendering
   • Up to unlimited FPS with frame interpolation
   • Full support for Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, and generic controllers
   • Dozens of quality-of-life improvements including graphics settings, HUD options, and enhanced
     camera
   • Runs on Windows, Linux (including Steam Deck), and macOS
Default Screenshot URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/briaguya0/pontoon/main/soh/screenshot-1.png
Categories: 
  - Game
  - AdventureGame
Provided Items: ↓
  Binaries: soh
